method: Read-only custom protobuf metadata inspection, official pinned shader/source inspection, 916 total bounded shard bytes read across first failed assumption and corrected examples. No complete shard scan, converter, package install, model mutation/copy, shader run or inference. Receipt is newly written; prior source and evidence remain unchanged.

firstDiagnostic.actual: All103 nodes contain explicit uint8 zero points. This was an incorrect instrument assumption, not a model defect.
firstDiagnostic.provenance: Transcribed from retained tool output; not a raw log.

correctedExamples.scope: Three nodes: first, middle, last; first row/first block and last row/last block; every128 value compared independently, including all32-byte boundaries. Does not claim full-shard numeric scan.

proof.coordinate: row n, reduction coordinate k, j=floor(k/128), t=k%128
proof.representedValue: (same uint8 q - same uint8 zero)*same float16 scale. No recalibration/requantization or scale arithmetic.
proof.scope: Every quantized scalar has identical operands by address algebra. Different GPU accumulation order may change activations/pixels; no output bit-parity or quality/speed acceptance.

wideTileGuards.other: block32; no indirect weight index; K divisible4 gives components_a4; 32-byte Q8 block gives8u32 and components_b4; nbits8 !=2. No optional subgroups feature required for this branch.

derivativeArtifacts.graph: One new independently hashed ONNX graph, same graph inputs/outputs and unchanged non-target nodes; original retained.
derivativeArtifacts.data: One new file containing duplicated scale and zero bytes only, with exact per-initializer offsets/lengths.
derivativeArtifacts.manifest: Separate variant manifest/receipt pins parent graph and original shard hashes plus converter and derivative hashes; canonical model manifest unchanged.
derivativeArtifacts.originalShards: Reuse exact existing immutable shard files via explicit externalData route mapping; keep original locations/offsets/lengths for B and all other unchanged tensors. No4GB B copy or path traversal. Old scale/zero ranges remain unused in retained originals.
